Huachai Deutz engines have CE, ISO9001/14001, TUV, TS16949 Certificates.

Our air and water-cooled diesel engines and generators are produced under the Deutz AG license and we are the exclusive licensed manufacturer of B/FL413/513 Series, BFM1015 series and TCD2015 series diesel engines
